propositions: RunawayPaginationError was declared to subclass RuntimeError, placing it outside BackendPaginationStallError's type hierarchy, so the three re-raise clauses in fetch_snapshot (parent, comment, issuelink enrichment handlers) never matched Cloud pagination stalls.

When a Cloud cursor stalled during enrichment, the unmatched RunawayPaginationError fell through to the broad except Exception fail-open handlers at fetcher.py:625/672/712, which logged a warning and wrote a silently degraded snapshot instead of propagating the stall.

The fix changes RunawayPaginationError to subclass BackendPaginationStallError directly, placing it in the core stall type hierarchy so the three re-raise clauses in fetch_snapshot will catch and propagate it.
Existing except RuntimeError sites remain unaffected because BackendPaginationStallError itself subclasses RuntimeError, preserving the MRO for backward compatibility.
Existing except RunawayPaginationError sites remain unaffected because the fix preserves the Cloud-specific exception class name and only changes its base type.
